purpose: Expanded clean-data diagnostic; no conflict-based selection
arms: Nested SHA256 samples: up to 128 versus 2048 frames per sensor-specific training class; include all background frames if fewer are available
controls: Same seed-11 initialization for both arms, architecture, 50 full-batch epochs, Adam learning rate, prevalence weighting, KL and gradient cap from original pilot; train-only statistics separately fitted for each arm
validation: Exactly the original 128-per-class clean validation keys for each sensor; no validation checkpoint selection; no corrupted images
reports: Training/validation class recalls and Brier, per-class training CE/KL history, source and sample sequence support/concentration, per-sequence confusion counts and keyed validation probabilities
policy: Descriptive diagnostics on correlated frames. Do not change loss to create opposition, declare production readiness or unlock test from this experiment. Save immutable clean pooled features for reuse.
